evidence.title: UCI Machine Learning Repository Iris dataset landing page (selected candidate metadata)
evidence.summary: Selected source candidate points to the UCI Machine Learning Repository page for the Iris dataset. Only candidate-level metadata was available: the URL, a search query referring to Iris, sepal length, petal length, Pearson correlation, and species, plus a partial verification note. No extracted page text, abstract, schema, sample counts, variable names, missing-value information, or correlation results were available.
extracted_claims: A candidate source record identifies an Iris dataset location at https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/iris.
The candidate was only partially verified at selection stage, and formal verification was deferred.
No extracted content from the source page was provided.
limitations: No extracted content was available for this source.
The selected candidate has no title, authors, publication year, snippet, DOI, PMID, or arXiv ID.
The source was only partially verified at candidate stage.
It cannot confirm dataset fields, sample size, species labels, missingness, or correlation values.
The candidate URL uses archive.ics.uci.edu, which may differ from canonical UCI repository URL forms; this was not resolved by extraction.
evidence.verification_note: Official or publisher-like URL is present.

claims.statement: A selected candidate source points to the UCI Machine Learning Repository Iris dataset page at https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/iris.
assumptions: The selected candidate metadata accurately records the source URL.
limitations: The page content was not extracted, so the existence and exact contents of the page are not independently confirmed.
The URL form was not validated against a canonical repository record.

claims.statement: No extracted source content was available to verify Iris dataset sample sizes, variable names, species labels, missing-data status, or sepal-length/petal-length correlations.
assumptions: The provided task warnings and empty extracted_source_content field accurately reflect extraction failure.
limitations: This observation describes the current evidence state, not the underlying Iris dataset itself.

claims.statement: The available selected source evidence is insufficient to determine whether sepal length and petal length have a stable linear association in the public Iris dataset overall.
assumptions: Answering the research question requires observed data or extracted literature/data results.
limitations: This does not imply the association is absent; it indicates current evidence is insufficient.

claims.statement: The available selected source evidence is insufficient to determine whether the sepal-length/petal-length linear association differs among setosa, versicolor, and virginica.
assumptions: Species-specific comparisons require species labels and group-level data or reported group-level statistics.
limitations: No species-level data, counts, or correlation estimates were available from the selected source.

claims.statement: Any answer about the Iris dataset would require direct computation on a clearly identified dataset version or extraction of reported statistics from a verified source; neither was available in the provided evidence.
assumptions: The task forbids inventing data, statistics, or source content.
limitations: This is a procedural evidence-gap conclusion, not a substantive finding about the Iris data.

evidence_gaps: No extracted content from the selected UCI Iris repository page was available.
No dataset version, file format, schema, or field names for sepal length, petal length, and species were confirmed.
No total or per-species sample sizes were confirmed.
No missing-value, duplicate-record, or outlier information was confirmed.
No overall Pearson correlation or confidence interval for sepal length versus petal length was available.
No species-specific Pearson correlations or confidence intervals were available.
No verified alternative sources were extracted to compare or corroborate dataset characteristics.
The canonical form and current availability of the provided UCI URL were not verified.
unsupported_claims: The public Iris dataset contains complete paired sepal-length and petal-length values for all samples.
The overall sepal-length/petal-length Pearson correlation is positive, strong, or stable.
The sepal-length/petal-length correlation differs across setosa, versicolor, and virginica.
Each Iris species has a specific sample size.
Any specific numeric correlation coefficient, mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, or quartile for the Iris variables.
confidence_summary: Confidence in substantive findings about the Iris dataset is very low because no source content or dataset values were extracted. The only supported observations concern the existence of a partially verified selected candidate URL and the current evidence gap. No stable linear association or species difference can be asserted from the provided evidence. Competing explanation: if the UCI page or dataset were successfully extracted or a dataset were supplied, descriptive and correlation analyses could be performed; without that, all dataset-specific claims remain unsupported.
